name: 可爱猿
evolution: 可爱猿 → 炽热猿 Lv.28 → 火焰猿 Lv.40
description: 头顶着活跃的微型火山，就连睡觉时也会冒出小烟圈。可别因为体型而小看了它，可爱猿头上流出的熔岩就连钢铁也能融化。
descriptionEn: Its head bears an active miniature volcano, and it even puffs little smoke rings while sleeping. Don't underestimate it because of its size—the lava flowing from Keaiyuan's head can even melt steel.

skills.name: 炎息
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 吹火
skills.description: 造成物伤，每次使用后，本技能威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each use permanently increases this skill's power by 20.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage taken by 70%; responds to attacks.

skills.name: 焚烧烙印
skills.description: 驱散双方所有印记，每驱散1层，敌方获得5层灼烧。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispel all marks on both sides; for each mark dispelled, the enemy gains 5 stacks of Burn.

skills.name: 怒火
skills.descriptionEn: Gain both attacks +120% and both defenses -40%.

skills.name: 灼伤
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 充分燃烧
skills.description: 使敌方身上的灼烧翻倍，并触发1次灼烧伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the enemy's Burn stacks and triggers one instance of Burn damage.

skills.name: 火云车
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 热身
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力翻倍，应对防御：改为威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: On the next attack, skill power is doubled; if responding to Defense, power becomes 4x instead.

skills.name: 闪燃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if responding to a status, this skill's power becomes 4x.

skills.name: 持续高温
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：下次攻击技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if responding to a status, the next attacking skill's power is doubled.
